title: Delhi Development Authority Approves Delhi Master Plan 2047
summary: The Delhi Development Authority approved the draft Master Plan for Delhi-2047 on 12 August 2026. The plan replaces the earlier draft Master Plan for Delhi-2041 and aligns with the Central Government’s Viksit Bharat @ 2047 vision....

blocks.content: The Delhi Development Authority approved the draft Master Plan for Delhi-2047 on 12 August 2026. The plan replaces the earlier draft Master Plan for Delhi-2041 and aligns with the Central Government’s Viksit Bharat @ 2047 vision.

items: The Delhi Development Authority was established in 1957 under the Delhi Development Act, 1957.
The Master Plan for Delhi is a statutory urban planning document for land use and development control in Delhi.
The Unified Building Bye-Laws, 2016 govern building permissions and construction norms in Delhi.
The Yamuna floodplain is a sensitive ecological zone linked to flood control and urban planning in Delhi.
